title: Demon Slayer Studio’s New Movie Is Getting a Major Update This Month
content: The animation studio behind Demon Slayer is all set for its return with another major project while fans await updates on the second part of the Infinity Castle trilogy. Demon Slayer is by far the biggest anime under Ufotable’s belt, but the studio has been known for several acclaimed shows and films, including series…

title: Black Clover Season 2 Shares First Look at Premiere With New Preview
content: Black Clover is finally making its return to screens with its highly anticipated second season this Fall, and now fans have gotten the first look at its big premiere with a new preview teasing what to expect.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Acclaimed Fantasy Creator Returns With New Look For Final Release
content: Yona of the Dawn concluded its main story in December last year, but the release of the final volume was delayed due to the side stories. Written and illustrated by Kusanagi Mizuho, the manga began serialization in Hakusensha’s Hana to Yume magazine in 2009.
author: ComicBook

title: Remow Launches 'It's Anime' Free Ad-Supported Channel on Live TV on PS5, Pluto TV, Prime Video
content: Anime distributor REMOW announced on Monday that it has launched the "It's Anime" free ad-supported streaming television channel (FAST) channel on Pluto TV on September 10, Amazon 's Prime Video on September 1, and PlayStation 5's Live TV on PS5 on August 31 in the U.S.
author: ANN

title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Opens at #1 at U.S. Box Office With US$60 Million
content: Box Office Mojo reported that Sony Pictures Entertainment 's live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise has earned an estimated US$60 million to top its opening weekend at the U.S. box office.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 1 Preview and Synopsis Revealed
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and the synopsis for Episode 1, titled “War Begins” (Episode 171 overall). The new season officially premieres on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. It will also have an early screening as part of Crunchyroll’s Anime Nights on September 21.
author: Anime Corner

title: Yuika Performs Promise Me the Spotlight Anime's Opening Song
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Monday that artist Yuika is performing the opening theme song for the television anime of Jun Wakatsuki 's Promise Me the Spotlight ( Watashi o Center ni Suru to Chikaimasuka? ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Seventh Opening Featuring "Funny Sunny Day" by SxOxU
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its seventh opening, featuring the song “Funny Sunny Day” by SxOxU. The song was used in Episodes 154-177, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Bride of the Barrier Master New Trailer Unveils More Cast
content: The newest trailer for the previously announced Bride of the Barrier Master anime unveiled five additional cast members on Monday. A visual was also released and Netflix will stream the series starting in January 2027. Akari Kito and Kikunosuke Toya star in the series as Hana Ichise and Saku Ichinomiya, respectively.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kekkaishi no Ichirinka' Unveils Additional Cast, Second Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kureha 's Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ( Bride of the Barrier Master ) novel unveiled additional cast, a third teaser visual (pictured), and second teaser promotional video on Monday. The anime series will premiere on Netflix in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
